articles.title: Visit to Boston made Boca Raton resident feel miserable about living in Boca Raton
articles.description:
“My trip to Boston made me realize my hometown sucks,” 20-year-old Ian Pinto titled a Reddit post he made after a four-day trip to Boston on July 31. 

The post Visit to Boston made Boca Raton resident feel miserable about living in Boca Raton appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Ian Pinto, 20, visited Boston for four days starting July 31.
Pinto expressed dissatisfaction with Boca Raton after experiencing Boston's culture.
His post highlights a growing sentiment among residents comparing cities.
